SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
ORDER BY fiscal_quarter DESC

SELECT TOP 10
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  SUM(f.standard_cost) AS total_standard_cost,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(f.standard_cost) AS gross_margin_eur,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(f.net_amount) > 0 
    THEN (SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(f.standard_cost)) / SUM(f.net_amount) * 100
    ELSE 0
  END AS gross_margin_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.region = 'South'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY gross_margin_eur DESC

SELECT

  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) AS total_refunds,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date IS NOT NULL THEN f.standard_cost ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date IS NOT NULL THEN r.standard_cost_returned ELSE 0 END) AS net_cost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) - 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date IS NOT NULL THEN f.standard_cost ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date IS NOT NULL THEN r.standard_cost_returned ELSE 0 END)) AS gross_margin_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key

LIMIT 10
